infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Thaw uses your approximate location to show quests and public landmarks near you. You can also explore a sample city instead.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Thaw uses the camera so you can photograph a landmark detail as quest evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Thaw lets you pick a photo of a landmark detail as quest evidence.
